note: Brand + group-buy pages at /brand/<slug>/. Text comes from Lydia's L5 drafts (Kingdom results/GB-SEO-LYDIA). status: open | closed | unknown. buy is null until an approved, valid go slug exists; null shows 開團時間待公告 and no link. No prices, dates or product lists are invented: an unknown field says so. indexable: false renders noindex,follow and keeps the page out of the sitemap. Bingo's rule (2026-11-02): a thin brand page stays noindex until the brand has a linked journal article (set `article`, it must exist under blog/) and at least one current or past group-buy product card; then switch it to true, one brand at a time. Run `npm run build:brand`.
